fields.title: Break down into phases
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: The `price` field in an order item is renamed to `price_at_purchase` and changes type. The mobile app updates for 90% of users in 6 weeks. Break down into phases and estimate the timeline.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Phase 1 — add new field, release 1. Phase 2 — dual write, 1–2 weeks of observation. Phase 3 — backfill 8 million records, shadow read, staged flag switch, 2–3 weeks. Phase 4 — drop old field no earlier than 6–8 weeks after phase 3, when old app versions leave. Total 3–4 months timeline for a couple of weeks of work. Mistake — planning phase 4 right after phase 3.
